items.title: France halts use of stun grenades after boy's hand blown off in student protests
items.description: The step comes after several groups complained of police using disproportionate force towards teenagers.

items.title: US death row inmate Christa Pike awake and speaking after failed execution, lawyers say
items.description: A medical expert advising her legal team says the murderer of Colleen Slemmer is communicating in a "basic way".

items.title: Residents of kibbutz destroyed in 7 October Hamas-led attacks grapple with how to rebuild
items.description: Three years on from the attack on Nir Oz, in which 47 people were killed and 76 taken hostage, some survivors have returned to live there.

items.title: Trump to speak to Putin about plague lab worker's death in Russia
items.description: Fears that the death may have been caused by pneumonic plague has prompted calls for more transparency from Russia.

items.title: Zelensky condemns 'vile' large-scale Russian attacks that killed 20
items.description: Rescue workers are continuing a search for residents after an apartment building in Pryluky was destroyed.

items.title: Sri Lanka's ex-first lady arrested over alleged misuse of children's hospital donations
items.description: The 73-year-old has been arrested over allegations that a charity she is linked to misused donations.

items.title: Chemistry Nobel awarded for solving mystery of life's asymmetry
items.description: The prize was given to the French and Japanese scientists for solving the mystery of life's asymmetry.

items.title: Ten people linked to Kenya's first-ever Ebola case quarantined as screening concerns grow
items.description: The patient passed through multiple cities in DR Congo, drove to Uganda and eventually flew to Kenya.

items.title: Japan beer giants raided over alleged price-fixing cartel
items.description: Asahi, Kirin and Suntory confirmed their premises were searched by Japanese competition authorities.

items.title: Oscar-winning actress Eva Marie Saint dies aged 102
items.description: She starred opposite Marlon Brando in On the Waterfront, then alongside Cary Grant in Hitchcock's North by Northwest.

items.title: California pair charged with abusing at least 14 surrogate-born children
items.description: Guojun Xuan and Silvia Zhang were arrested at their Arcadia mansion after 21 children were removed from their custody last year.

items.title: India's opposition leader dragged on to bus as police break up protest
items.description: Opposition leaders allege that CEC Gyanesh Kumar manipulated voter rolls to favour PM Narendra Modi's party.
